Current story direction · Working canon

The Morninghollow Trilogy

A story of lost light, liberation, and restoration. The sequence below includes major story spoilers and records the current direction, not a completed script.

Spoilers for all three story arcs

This is the current creator-directed trilogy story. Some scene details and continuity questions remain open; the earlier Prologue is preserved separately as an archive.

Before Dayfall

The Fall and the broken Wall

When humanity eats the forbidden fruit, the resulting disturbance reaches Morninghollow and breaks the Wall between Day and Night. Whether the explosion described in the earlier Prologue is this same rupture or a later one remains unresolved.

Part I

Dayfall: Vry is captured

The player commands Day under Vry or Night under Voy. After the commander falls, Vry and Voy fight directly. If Vry wins, Megatroid helps Voy before capturing Vry. If Voy wins, Megatroid takes Vry without another fight. Both paths converge: Megatroid takes Vry's light and becomes Lightender.

Dayfall guide
The Keyless Abyss

Christ's victory and Vry's escape

After Vry is imprisoned, the cinematic moves through the Crucifixion, a dark forest, and the Horseman of Death. Jesus confronts Death with the line “I am the Gate,” descends, and takes the keys. Vry's prison shatters; Jesus tells him to get up and run, and Vry escapes with his wings wrapped around himself.

This is Morninghollow's visual interpretation, grounded in Revelation 1:18 and Acts 2:27–31, with the gate line echoing John 10:9. Luke 23:39–43 is the reference for the two criminals and the promise of paradise. The forest encounter and Vry's simultaneous release are fictional scene elements.

Revelation 1:18 Acts 2:27–31 John 10:9 Luke 23:39–43
Part II

Lightender: the pursuit after escape

Vry is free, but Megatroid still holds his light. A human helps Vry confront Megatroid. The title Lightender belongs to Megatroid; the second game follows Vry after his escape.

Lightender guide
Part III · Future

Megatroid: restoration

Megatroid turns toward good and reclaims his original name. The player will control him as he works to restore the light he shattered within humanity. The game's systems and engine have not yet been chosen.

Megatroid overview

Open continuity questions

  • Is the man in the forest one of the two criminals, and what exactly happens when Death takes him?
  • Does the Fall break the Wall once, or does a later event cause a second breach?
  • How does Megatroid take and possess Vry's light?
  • How do the Crucifixion, Vry's imprisonment, and Vry's escape relate across Morninghollow's dimensions and time?
  • What leads Megatroid to redemption, and how does he restore humanity's light?

The source-of-truth working record is maintained in the internal Morninghollow Canon Bible. This public page summarizes approved story direction without filling in unresolved answers.
